mentions.name: Viberglass
mentions.description: Open-source hosted ticketing system and agent harness platform that integrates with other ticket systems and chat apps to trigger agentic coding tasks without context switching or knowing how to install tools, SDKs, or IDEs. Runs ephemeral workloads in isolated containers or cloud compute, aiming to commoditize small-scale development tasks and keep them from getting lost in the backlog. Can be self-hosted locally or on AWS with full infrastructure-as-code included. It began as a way for the author's wife to keep her website up to date without coding skills.
mentions.problem: Small-scale development tasks get lost in the backlog, and handling them requires context switching plus knowledge of installing the wanted tools, SDKs, and IDEs.
mentions.source_excerpt: It is a hosted ticketing system/agent harness platform with integrations towards other ticket systems and chat apps. It allows triggering agentic (coding) tasks without the need to context switch and/or know anything about installing the wanted tools, SDKs, IDEs etc.
